_comment: Which pack machine crafts a Factorio recipe category (ADR-0026's conversion input).
Routing is on a recipe's FIRST category. Factorio 2.x gives a recipe a list, and the
extra entries are the DLC machines that may also craft it -- `transport-belt` is
["crafting", "metallurgy"] because Vulcanus's foundry exists, not because a belt is a
metallurgy recipe. Routing on anything but the first entry would hand Terra's recipes to
machines this map does not build.
A `!` prefix means the category is deliberately not routed: the converter emits nothing
and says why. It is not the same as a category missing from this file, which is a hard
failure -- a new Factorio version adding a category must not silently drop its recipes.

A `recipe_type` of null is a machine that is not registered yet, and `blocked_by` names the ticket that registers it. `scripts/factorio-recipe-convert.py` reads both, so the converter holds no table of its own. A null with no `blocked_by` is a machine nobody has ticketed.

assembling.note: ADR-0026's Assembling Machine 1/2/3 and the Personal Assembler's hand set, on the pack's own `planetaryfactory:assembling` (#279). One type across the three Factorio categories, each recipe carrying its `category`, so ADR-0038's hand set stays a predicate over this type rather than a type of its own. Its GregTech type left with ADR-0060; the pack's type is what `RuntimeHandRecipes` reads today, and the Assembling Machine block #277 decides is to read the same type rather than bring its own.

chemical_plant.note: ADR-0025's Chemical Plant. Its `gtceu:chemical_plant` type left with ADR-0060; #277 decides the block (the proposal is Oritech's centrifuge) and with it the recipe type and its JSON shape.

oil_refinery.note: ADR-0025's Oil Refinery. Its `gtceu:oil_refinery` type left with ADR-0060; #277 decides the block (the proposal is `oritech:refinery`) and with it the recipe type and its JSON shape.

smelting.note: Plates and stone brick, on the pack's own `planetaryfactory:smelting` (#155) and on nothing else. The three furnace tiers are `planetaryfactory_core` blocks (Stone, Steel, Electric), which is why `subgroup-owner.json` reads `pack:smelting`. ADR-0032 deleted ADR-0017's Ore processing row -- ore is 1:1, so smelting rides nothing and is the whole of ore-to-plate. The type carries a count on the ingredient, which is what lets `steel-plate` (5 plates to 1) and `stone-brick` (2 stone to 1, ADR-0046) be expressed at all; vanilla `minecraft:smelting` can express neither, and is not read alongside it because ADR-0034's sweep leaves it with no live recipe.

centrifuge.note: ADR-0033. Uranium processing and nuclear fuel reprocessing; Kovarex when the post-launch map reaches it. #135 registers it, and the id will be `gtceu:`.

rocket_silo.note: The Rocket Part. #29 and #41 settle what a launch consumes; the silo is GCyR's.
